_readme: Add a series by adding an entry here — no new script needed.
Run one source:  MODE=discover python scripts/fetch.py NAME   (dump real structure first)
Providers: fred (any FRED id) | eurostat (any dataset+params) | owid (any grapher slug) | csv (any URL)
Everything runs in GitHub Actions — the dev sandbox cannot reach these hosts.

sources.name: cattle-herd
sources.source: FAOSTAT cattle stocks (head), via Our World in Data

sources.name: us-prices
sources.source: BLS producer price indexes via FRED, plus CPI for deflating
sources.note: PPI levels are index numbers (1982=100) — ratios only, never quantities

sources.name: eu-vet-expenses
sources.source: Eurostat Economic Accounts for Agriculture, veterinary expenses
sources.note: ALL livestock, not cattle only — do not present as a per-cattle figure without saying so

sources.name: eu-hicp
sources.source: Euro area HICP via FRED — deflator for any EUR money series

sources.name: us-cowcalf-costs
sources.source: USDA ERS commodity costs and returns, cow-calf
sources.note: SURVEY BASIS CHANGED IN 2008 — do not compare across that break

sources.name: _probe-findings
_findings: Probed Jul 2026, all verified against real fetches — do not re-test these:
MISSING on FRED: WPU0135, WPU0136 (poultry farm gate), WPU02830131, CUSR0000SEFC.
TOO SHORT: WPU0134 poultry farm-gate PPI starts 2021-09 — use PCU311615311615 instead,
but that is a PROCESSING index, not farm gate: not the same object as WPU0131.
EMPTY for TR: aact_eaa01 (no economic accounts), apro_mt_pann IMP (no trade).
PRESENT for TR: apro_mt_lscatl 2012-2025 — Eurostat does carry Turkish head counts.
NO TRADE SERIES anywhere in the proven providers: study of TR import dependence
needs UN Comtrade or TurkStat, neither wired up.

sources.name: us-species-ppi
sources.source: BLS producer price indexes via FRED, monthly to Jun 2026
sources.note: Farm gate for hogs/eggs/grains. Poultry has NO usable farm-gate PPI: PCU311615311615 is processing-level.

sources.name: us-retail-meat
sources.source: BLS average retail prices (dollars per pound/dozen) and CPI/PPI components via FRED
sources.note: APU series are REAL UNITS, not indexes — the one place in this project where a level is meaningful. Do not divide them by the PPI indexes to get a farm share; that needs USDA ERS meat price spreads.

sources.name: us-rates
sources.source: Federal Reserve H.15 and Treasury via FRED
sources.note: DFII10/T10YIE start 2003 — before that, build ex-post real rates against CPIAUCSL in us-prices.

sources.name: eu-cattle-categories
sources.source: Eurostat livestock survey, Nov-Dec count, 23 cattle categories
sources.note: A2300F dairy cows / A2300G non-dairy cows; A2220C and A2230C are heifers NOT for slaughter, i.e. the replacement pipeline.

sources.name: tr-cattle-categories
sources.source: Eurostat livestock survey, Türkiye, Nov-Dec count
sources.note: Türkiye IS in this dataset, 2012-2025 — more current than FAOSTAT, which stops at 2024.

sources.name: eu-slaughter-species
sources.source: Eurostat annual slaughter and trade by species
sources.note: meatitem covers SLAUGHT plus IMP/EXP; meat runs from B1000 bovine down to B7110 broiler. Split on unit too — the dataset carries three.

sources.name: eu-cost-lines
sources.source: Eurostat Economic Accounts for Agriculture, input lines, EU27 2005-2025
sources.note: Feed AM206000, vet AM205000, energy AM202000, maintenance AM207000/AM208000, labour AM290000, interest AM350000. ALL LIVESTOCK/ALL FARMING, never cattle alone. Unfiltered queries are refused with 413.

sources.name: herd-pigs
sources.source: FAOSTAT pig stocks (head) via Our World in Data, 1961-

sources.name: cattle-by-country
sources.source: Eurostat livestock survey apro_mt_lscatl, Nov-Dec count, by member state
sources.note: Key is GEO|ANIMAL. Candidate/EFTA geos are requested too — absent ones simply return no rows. Category start years differ by country; check before comparing endpoints.

sources.name: milk-by-country
sources.source: Eurostat apro_mk_farm — raw cows' milk from farm, 1000 t, by country
sources.note: Divide by dairy cows A2300F from cattle-by-country to get yield per cow. Milk is 1000 t, cows are 1000 head.

sources.name: eaa-inputs-by-country
sources.source: Eurostat EAA — veterinary expenses and feed, by country
sources.note: Veterinary covers ALL LIVESTOCK, never cattle alone: a per-cattle-head figure from this is a proxy and must be labelled one. Nominal EUR — deflate with HICP before comparing years.

sources.name: eaa-output-by-country
sources.source: Eurostat EAA — live cattle output value and milk output value, by country
sources.note: AM111000 IS cattle-specific, unlike the veterinary line. Nominal EUR.

sources.name: slaughter-by-country
sources.source: Eurostat apro_mt_pann — bovine slaughterings by country
sources.note: KG_HD is carcass weight per head: the direct efficiency measure. THS_HD head, THS_T tonnes.
